Preserve this visual grammar without copying its incline-press pose. Dark floor, no bright white soles, no bright colored lighting. Square framing, full athlete and all required equipment in frame, about 8% dark crop-safe perimeter, occupy most of frame. Hands must anatomically grip the real handles; two arms, two hands, two legs; credible joints, contact, supports and equipment. Only required equipment. Generate canonical ID 290 JM PRESS. Input one is the ONLY visual style reference. Render in original dark violet studio, graphite sleeveless shirt/shorts.
